theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns on the Hang Seng universe. Banks is currently eligible (trend-gate=true), the theme leader, and shows moderate durability (0.45) and no crowding. We lean overweight within the constraint that the trend discipline persists – this is a risk-control expression, not an alpha call.

falsifier.text: Banks eligibility drops to false (trend-gate fails) or durability-bar falls below 0.3 within the horizon.
